question: Does retaining source-task function support co-occurrence avoid the compatible-task loss from a pooled within-class covariance?
source_learning: Fit one existing noise-aware ARD covariance to each of the40 historical tasks separately after exact precision collapse of repeated candidate visits. Use the common public seed48 normalization, original isotropic source-signal initialization,120 iteration cap, original one-percent signal tail,0.25 intercept variance and0.02 discrepancy. Each fit uses only its own observed eta labels; reuse that fit across eligible outer folds. No regime labels, analytic truth, support count or archive grouping informs a fit. All nonintercept means remain zero.
prior: For each held seed pair, exclude all10 tasks from those seeds. Retain the30 eligible source-task covariances with equal empirical masses. Use a common intercept mean from those30 source fits for every empirical component; no per-archive intercept transfer. Target signed function coefficients start at zero. The prior retains the empirical distribution of simultaneous function variance directions, not a newly fitted frequency classification.
comparisons: D places1/4 on each original local structural/full atom and1/2 on the empirical task-direction distribution. DG replaces each empirical covariance with its own same-trace isotropic covariance, retaining mean, discrepancy and atom mass. P replaces the empirical distribution by its exact average covariance, retaining the same mean, discrepancy and total mass. All components update from strictly past eta only. Compare D-I, D-DG, D-P and D-A37_L; do not recalibrate the mass or infer a preferred variant from the scores.
analysis: Same80 held source-validation paths and steps9-24; average old policies within each task and report all five regimes plus four seed-pair blocks with20000 paired bootstrap draws. Primary outcome is marginal next-observed-eta log score; early9-12 and late21-24 D-I retained. No latent truth scoring or cohort56-63.
controls: Original I must reproduce saved A37 on unchanged paid paths. Every scored seed is absent from its empirical prior. Nonintercept means remain zero. DG has the same per-component total coefficient variance and P the exact empirical first two prior coefficient moments. All atom masses and intercept/discrepancy choices are fixed before scoring.
gate: Promote to further source validation only if all40 task ARD optimizers converge, overall D-I, D-DG and D-P95 percent intervals are strictly positive, and no regime has a strictly negative D-I or D-DG interval. Failure preserves the full failed candidate and stops calibration, evaluation and KG. No automatic iteration extension or mass/support-count search.
limitations: A single noisy historical task cannot establish a known support. The equal empirical distribution has finite archive coverage and point-estimated ARD hyperparameters. This is a different prespecified development hypothesis on already-studied seeds, not independent confirmation or a solution to head sharing/HVD/decision alignment.
